prose.en: Tori settles against uke's right side, passes his right arm between uke's legs and grips uke's trousers or belt. He passes his left arm under uke's neck and grips deeply on the left side collar. Tori bends his right knee and places it against uke's right hip, while the left leg is stretched out to the left rear with the toes planted. Puffing out his chest, he presses uke's chest and holds him down.
Image of the entry and of the hold Tori enters and settles into yoko-shiho-gatame. Tori holds uke down while controlling uke's neck and legs.
Uke shifts his body sideways, closes in on tori and hooks a leg around him. Uke uses a sideways evading movement of the body to come close to tori and entangle tori's leg.
Tori scoops up uke's armpit from the front and turns him over into the hold. Tori scoops up uke's armpit from the front, moves to the side, turns uke over and holds him down.

heading.en: Faults that are easy to fall into

prose.en: Tori's right knee should be placed so that it presses against uke's hip.
Uke should not force himself up using his hands or elbows as props.
